label: captain
definition: Whoever drives an approved plan: cckit watch --merge, /kit-autopilot, or an orchestrating session. It gates the open PRs, squash-merges the CLEAN ones, closes their issues, advances the wave, and pings a person only on a genuine blocker.
is_not: A builder: a builder implements one issue in its worktree and never merges.
A reviewer: the captain reads the gate and the review verdicts, it does not review the code.
The owner: the owner approves the plan; the captain executes it.
